title: Stagehand
description: A mod for build artists playing in survival multiplayer settings!
body:
![Banner with blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af1eae1efade3f0094ef57c5f19ed3aef12282e9.jpeg)

# Stagehand

**A dedicated toolkit for builders in SMP.**
Highly configurable and taking suggestions for builders' needs.

### Core Features

**The Stage Dimension**: A pocket dimension for builds. Set worldspawn with /setstagehub or make adventures for your friends. Visitors are in Adventure Mode by default. Whitelists for builders!

**Safety Net**: Players who die in your pocket dimension simply return to whence they came.

**Contraptable**: Integrate teleportation to and from your builds seamlessly with redstone, with location aware teleports.

**Control Loot**: In Creative Mode, configure an instanced loot chest exactly how you like it in game and control if and when it refills.

**Super Easy Particle Effects**: The most comprehensive and powerful way to create particle effects in Minecraft (more particle options coming too).

**Custom Ambience**: Fill your builds with SOUND with a simple speaker and an easy to use interface.

**Loreify Anything**: Take any item to the Lore Desk and change the name, lore, and color with a GUI - none of this arcane symbol garbage.

**Block Linking**: Make any block behave like any other block. Link ice to powdered snow to make it freeze players, link your room to magma to burn them. Link a prop to a lectern to create lore. Link a mud block to a button, I don't know use your imagination.
